g.text: Systematic decision trees & branch recoveries for PIN rejection, relay reachability, and device handshake stalls.
Host daemon & client clock desync breaks rolling TOTP token validation. Gateway rejects valid codes.
Resynchronize NTP pool on host machine; ensures pairing timestamp lies within 60s window.
Generated 6-digit one-time PIN expires after 3 minutes for replay protection. Re-entry fails.
Issue fresh PIN from host GUI or terminal CLI. Optionally extend nonce TTL for mobile entry.
Client Public Key Revoked / Cache Conflict
Previously authorized hardware ID was purged from host whitelist. Client attempts cached handshake.
Clear stale client localStorage in remote client and initiate clean enrollment grant on host.
Strict corporate NAT or egress filter blocks outbound WebSocket packets to relay IP address.
Ensure outbound TCP 443 allows persistent TLS connections; verify no corporate DPI drops WSS frames.
Private self-hosted relay uses expired cert or custom CA certificate missing from client trust store.
Install custom root CA in client profile or deploy valid Let's Encrypt certificate on relay domain.
Relay is up, but host machine daemon never registered outbound connection to relay broker.
ferryx relay ping && ferryx gateway restart --relay
Restart host gateway daemon; check ~/.ferryx/daemon.log for relay registration confirmation token.
Nginx, Caddy, or Cloudflare drops HTTP 101 WebSocket Upgrade headers, hanging the duplex session.
Ensure reverse proxy preserves Upgrade and Connection headers for /gateway and /relay paths.
Daemon Socket Conflict / Stale PID Lock
Daemon IPC socket owned by root or stale pid lock prevents gateway from accepting client stream.
Run ferryx doctor to clear orphaned socket files and verify current user ownership (0600 mode).
Mobile OS backgrounded browser tab mid-handshake, dropping initial ANSI ring buffer replay.
Tap the status badge in mobile client to request full ring-buffer replay without tearing session.
